name: Sarah Johnson
title: Senior Property Consultant
bio: With over 10 years of experience in Bristol's property market, Sarah specializes in high-end properties in Clifton and surrounding areas. Her extensive knowledge of the local market and dedication to client satisfaction have earned her numerous industry awards.

name: David Chen
title: Lettings Manager
bio: David has been helping tenants find their perfect homes for over 7 years. He specializes in city centre apartments and student lettings, with particular expertise in the Redland and Bishopston areas. Known for his efficiency and attention to detail.

name: Emma Williams
title: Property Investment Specialist
bio: Emma specializes in investment properties and buy-to-let opportunities in Bristol's up-and-coming areas. With a background in finance and 5 years in real estate, she provides valuable insights on rental yields and property appreciation potential.

name: James Taylor
title: New Homes Consultant
bio: James specializes in new build properties and developments across Bristol. He's particularly passionate about helping first-time buyers navigate the property market and find their perfect starter home. His knowledge of government schemes and mortgage options is extensive.

name: Priya Patel
title: Commercial Property Specialist
bio: Priya has over 8 years of experience in commercial real estate, specializing in office spaces and retail units across Bristol. Her client portfolio includes both local businesses and international corporations looking to establish a presence in the city.
